name: fuseway
description: @fuseway chat participant: routes requests to a local model, Claude Code, Codex, or an explicitly selected Grok Build CLI.

chatParticipants.name: fuseway
chatParticipants.description: Picks the local model, Claude or Codex; Grok is available on request

commands.name: grok
commands.description: Use the official Grok Build CLI and its configured authentication

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show subscription windows and fuseway's recent calls

commands.name: stats
commands.description: How the routers and agents are scoring, and who decides now

commands.name: version
commands.description: Show the installed Fuseway build and workspace Git state without an agent

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show Fuseway setup, model and subscription status without an agent

commands.name: company
commands.description: Run an owner-configured agent company: init, status, run, challenge, stop

fuseway.allowEdits.description: Let backends edit files in the workspace. Off: Claude runs in plan mode and Codex read-only.

fuseway.codexEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for frontier work.

fuseway.frontier.description: balance: send frontier work to whichever subscription has more room left after its reserve, counting both its 5-hour and weekly windows. grok explicitly selects Grok Build; its quota is not part of automatic balancing.

fuseway.claudeReserve.description: Share of Claude's 5-hour and weekly windows kept for your own Claude Code sessions. Headless calls share those windows with you; once only this much is left, @fuseway sends frontier work to Codex.

fuseway.codexReserve.description: Share of Codex's windows kept for your own Codex sessions.

fuseway.learning.enabled.description: Score routers and agents from outcomes in the background, and switch to a better decision maker when the evidence is clear. Everything stays in ~/.local/state/fuseway/learning.jsonl on this machine.

fuseway.learning.dailyPaidTokens.description: Most Claude tokens per day the background learner may spend testing paid routers (about 1K per Haiku check). 0 tests only free ones.

fuseway.codexModel.description: Optional Codex model ID. Empty uses the Codex CLI default. Replies report the observed model, or unknown if unavailable.

fuseway.grokModel.description: Optional Grok model ID. Empty uses the Grok Build CLI default. Replies report observed model IDs. Use grok models to list models.
